units: Bytes are decimal (1 KB = 1,000 B, 1 MB = 1,000,000 B), as scripts/media/check-budgets.mjs counts them; engineGzip and engineMinified are top-level, the names plan 4 and 6.5 give them, and scripts/check-bundle.mjs fails when either is missing. P4b re-pinned both at the measured size + 5%, rounded up to the next 1,000 and never above the plan caps (307,200 B gzip, 950,000 B minified): engineGzip from the Load click (engine, HUD and their shared chunk) at 223,640 B gzip -9, engineMinified from the engine chunk at 818,105 B. P5 re-pinned both the same way once interiors, Walk and the Walk HUD were in: the Load click at 251,602 B gzip -9 (engineGzip 265,000) and the engine chunk at 896,349 B (engineMinified 942,000, within 1% of the plan cap). P7 re-pinned engineGzip alone, once Plan (P6) and P7's drained notch resize and bench tap were in: the Load click at 263,917 B gzip -9, so 278,000; the engine chunk measured 905,212 B, inside 942,000, which stays (its +5% would pass the 950,000 cap). engineGzip is also what the consent label counts for the engine, so check-bundle holds the whole click to it. w.perFile is 131,072 B, 128 KiB, so it is the same number as upstream's config/estate.toml [web] max_walk_gz: a walk file that passes U2's gate passes P2's. Class bytes are what travels: the gzip file for .glb.gz, .walk.gz and .bin.gz, the file itself otherwise. pixelCap counts drawing-buffer pixels; gpuBytes is geometry plus the drawing buffer (plan 7.7).
